Name: Ria's Storage Network
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[size=4]This mod is directly inspired by [url=https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/refined-storage]Refined Storage[/url] of Minecraft and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=2563309347]Magic Storage[/url] of Terraria. [/size]
[youtube]aV7g2H_zYyw[/youtube]
[youtube]SQrh54qRa54[/youtube]

[b][size=4]Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Combine chests (and other storage items) into a storage network by placing them next to a Storage Core.[/*]
[*]Access all your items in one unified vault, searchable and sortable by name, amount and category.[/*]
[*]Multiple storage tiers starting from Wood Cache that can hold 64 items up to the max tier Radioactive Cache that can hold 1024 items.[/*]
[*]A chest connected to the Storage Core ignores its own slots. A Chest and a Big Chest with the same Cache hold the same amount.[/*]
[*]Choose which chests to enable or disable. Disabled chests moves its items to the other enabled chest.[/*]
[*]Placed chests next to a Storage Core cannot be opened. Chests won't be removed if it currently has cache in it. Cache won't be removed if the chests currently holds items.[/*]
[*]Prisms that can filter which items are put into the machines and which items are pulled from the machines back into the storage network.[/*]
[*]Craft your items directly in the storage network (crafted items will be placed in your inventory).[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Complete support (mods with direct integrations)[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10384]Convenient Storage[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21591]The Return Of Custom Backpack Framework[/url] (and mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21591]The Return Of More Backpack Upgrades[/url])[/*]
[/list][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Compatible with[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]All GUI mods (thanks to StardewUI)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/518]Chests Anywhere[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7431]Expanded Storage[/url] (and all packs added by it)[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/541]Lookup Anything[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22539]Resource Storage[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30323]Unlimited Storage[/url][/*]
[/list]
[color=#f9cb9c][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Pathoschild]Pathoschild [/url]for [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1063]Automate[/url] [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato/mods]mushymato [/url]and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/focustense/mods]focustense [/url]for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43861]StardewUI[/url][/*]
[/list][color=#f9cb9c][size=4][b]Mods Featured in Screenshots[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7807]6480's Storage Variety[/url][/*]
[/list]I finally get to publish a C# mod after trying to learn C# for 2 years. Hoping this mod helps a lot of players in managing their items.
